subject: Next step: product showcase + ops/integration check
messages:
From: Sergio Álvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Lewis <matthew.lewis@brightaxis.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Next step: product showcase + ops/integration check

Hi Matthew —

Thanks again for carving out 30 minutes this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and to propose next steps: 

What we heard
- Goal: reduce inference cost and get predictable latency for customer-facing features (billing, invoices rendering pipeline).
- Constraints: on-prem data residency for PII, existing GKE infra with strict egress rules, and an SRE team that manages deployments.
- Success metrics: 80% lower per-token cost vs current managed endpoint and p95 < 200ms for 512-token requests.

Recommended next step
We suggest a 30-minute product showcase + ops/integration check to demonstrate the runtime, quantization benefits, and expected network/egress requirements. This will give your SREs the details they need to assess deployment friction.

Can you confirm which of these 3 compact windows works for your team (all times PT):
1) Mon Nov 17 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Tue Nov 18 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Wed Nov 19 — 11:30–12:00 PM PT

Please also indicate the two technical stakeholders you’d like on the call (SRE, infra lead, or product). If you prefer a different band, tell us and we’ll adjust. I’ve attached a one‑pager and a proposed 30‑minute agenda.

Next steps from our side
- I’ll have Laura join as the Solutions Engineer to cover integration specifics.
- Priyom will bring the commercial context and next‑step checklist for pilots.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

—
Sergio Álvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0192

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear recap. Looking good. Janelle (our infra lead) and I reviewed the options — we can do either Tue Nov 18 2:00–2:30 PM PT or Wed Nov 19 11:30–12:00 PM PT. Prefer Tue if Laura is available.

Quick Q: can you confirm whether the showcase will include a short run‑through of the VPC/on‑prem control plane requirements? Janelle will want to see the egress/peering requirements up front.

If you lock Tue, I’ll invite Janelle and our SRE (Tariq) — Tariq may drop a follow‑up question about firewall ports.

Thanks,
Matt
VP Product, BrightAxis
matthew.lewis@brightaxis.com
